span.p:
PHASE 1 – PROJECT SETUP
Thiết lập dự án
Project Information – Lead/Checker • Scope Check – Lead/Checker • Scope Boundary • Input Documents • Latest Information Check • Contract Review by Detailer • Trace Design Intent • Document Conflict Check

div.style: color: rgb(107, 78, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(18, 59, 94) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PHASE 2 – MODELING
Dựng Model
Model Setup • Architecture Check • Structure Check • Device / Fixture Check • Equipment Check • Routing Strategy • Power Conduit / Feeder • Lighting Conduit / Circuit • Cable Tray • Busway • Grounding & Bonding • Fire Alarm / Low Voltage Conduit • Emergency / Life Safety Circuits • Panelboard / Transformer Connections
(see detailed diagram below)

div.style: color: rgb(107, 78, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(18, 59, 94) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PHASE 3 – ENGINEERING & SUPPORTS
Kỹ thuật & Giá đỡ
Access / Maintenance • Fireproofing & Firestop • Hanger / Support • Penetration Strategy • Deck / Floor Sleeve • Wall / Roof Sleeve / Opening • Core Drill • Deck Insert

div.style: color: rgb(107, 78, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(18, 59, 94) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PHASE 4 – COORDINATION
Phối hợp
Elevation Check • Coordination • Customer Issue / RFI • Customer Response

div.style: color: rgb(107, 78, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(18, 59, 94) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PHASE 5 – TRIMBLE / FIELD LAYOUT
Trimble / Layout hiện trường
Trimble / Field Layout Point • Underground Stub-Up • Device Rough-In • Field Layout Release • Pour Schedule Control

div.style: color: rgb(107, 78, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(18, 59, 94) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PHASE 6 – PREFABRICATION
Prefab hoá
Prefabrication Ready • Prefab Planning / Break • Field Connection • Prefab Drawing / Ticket • Prefab Dimension • Prefab QC / Release

div.style: color: rgb(107, 78, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(18, 59, 94) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PHASE 7 – BOM / REPORTS
BOM / Báo cáo
BOM – Bill of Materials • Pending / Hold Register • Superseded File Control

div.style: color: rgb(107, 78, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(18, 59, 94) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

PHASE 8 – SHOP CONDUIT / CABLE TRAY DRAWINGS
Bản vẽ Shop Conduit / Cable Tray
IFR → Customer Comments → IFA → Approval Response → IFC → PDF/Filename/Transmittal → Shop Sleeve
(see detailed diagram below)

div.style: color: rgb(107, 78, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PHASE 9 – QC / FINAL REVIEW
QC / Rà soát cuối
Constructability • Detailer Self-Check • Checker QC • QC Comment Update • Revision Impact • Field Feedback • Final Closeout • FINAL SIGN-OFF – DETAILER • FINAL SIGN-OFF – LEAD/CHECKER
(see detailed diagram below)
